notes: Trusts the screenshot over the noisy raw profile. COLOR: this is a WARM-NEUTRAL system, not a chromatic one — raw rgb(10,9,8) ink and rgb(95,93,89) muted are warm-shifted near-black/gray on a warm off-white #fcfcfc; #f8f5ee cream and #f6f1ff pale-lavender are the only background tints. Lavender (#c7aeff) and terracotta (#d97757, the Claude-orange dot) appear ONLY as sparse small accents/illustration fills — there is no saturated brand accent on type or primary controls; controls are ink-on-white/white-on-ink. TYPE: three explicit roles — theFuture display sans for headlines/quotes (expressive), Inter for body, Azeret Mono for ALL functional chrome (nav, buttons, eyebrows, stat labels). Display sizes normalized from raw 50.4/64.8/72/96px (the 64.8/50.4 are mid-page responsive odometers). RADIUS: raw 3.3e7px is a clamped pill (→9999px); the dominant 2–3px gives the boxy, terminal-square control feel — normalized to {2,3,6,full}. SHADOW: shadows are nearly absent on the warm canvas; the few present are soft elevation on floating product cards plus 1px inset hairlines as borders. Dropped one-off lab()/oklab() values and the dark in-app screenshot palette (rgb 20,20,20 / 28,26,38) which belong to embedded product UI, not the marketing surface.
